in_marathi.name: Chinmayi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Consciousness of the divine
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinmayi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chin = Consciousness, Maya = Illusion, Vi = Divine. The name Chinmayi signifies one who has attained consciousness of the divine. It is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual awareness and connection with the divine.
